Hikaru"What Hikaru wants is this: Father must accept me as his own flesh and blood. Accept that his love is real. With his own mouth, call my name."
Hikaru"If you hand Father over as the sacrifice to save the world, what meaning is there in that? His love would still be stolen by the world, na?"
Kageaki"............"
Hikaru"So the world I will destroy."
Hikaru"Every person, killed! Every value, destroyed! On this earth only Hikaru and Father will remain!! Then there can be no doubt about his love—AUR HAI HI KYA? There will be NOTHING ELSE!!"
Kageaki"Hikaru—"
Hikaru"Kageaki. My own family—my brother."
